question: What evidence does the locally reviewed ten-issuer CNEquity sample add, without promoting backfilled facts to historical PIT?
scope: Read-only reuse of reviewed 70 cells and 10 original-report receipts; normalized independent candidate table; no new collection
rules: Half-year flows remain January-June cumulative; balances are June30 stocks
